verdict.rationale: Zapier's platform is built around triggers/actions including polling triggers (zapier-docs-3) and Visual Builder/CLI workflow creation (zapier-docs-19, zapier-docs-22), which implicitly support recurring, trigger-based automations, but the evidence pack never shows an AI agent explicitly scheduling or configuring a recurring job through MCP — the MCP examples (zapier-docs-7, zapier-docs-20, zapier-docs-24) describe one-off actions like booking a single meeting or calling an action, not setting up persistent recurring workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an AI/MCP-driven interface for creating or managing scheduled/recurring Zaps, and independent confirmation that AI agents can configure recurrence intervals rather than just trigger single actions.
